local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local r=RS:WaitForChild('GameAction') local note='INTRO' local a=r:InvokeServer('State',{}) local step=(a and a.view and a.view.captain and a.view.captain.step) or '?' note=note..' step='..tostring(step) if step=='name' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroName',{name='QA선장'}) note=note..' name='..tostring(x and x.ok) task.wait(0.3) step='companion' end if step=='companion' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroCompanion',{}) note=note..' comp='..tostring(x and x.ok) task.wait(0.3) step='portrait' end if step=='portrait' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroPortrait',{portrait='hero:england'}) note=note..' portrait='..tostring(x and x.ok) end task.wait(0.5) workspace:SetAttribute('DevCall','State') task.wait(2) local pg=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local left=0 for _,d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('TextButton') and (d.Text=='장부에 올린다' or d.Text=='함께 가자' or d.Text=='이 얼굴로 그려 주세요') and d.Visible then left+=1 end end return note..' dialogsLeft='..left
